notablePrerequisites:
Moritte of the Frost on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Moritte of the Frost do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Moritte of the Frost.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Moritte of the Frost.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
